title: Reading Drill — Keeping a Garden Journal
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Keeping a Garden Journal
passages.body:
**A** A school recorded when flowers opened in its garden. The pupils first wrote the date of the first bloom without noting whether other plants of the same type were flowering.

**B** In the following year they added a field for the number of plants in bloom. This helped distinguish a single early flower from a general change across the whole garden.

**C** Entries also included a small drawing or photograph. This allowed another class to check a plant identification if a note used a less familiar local name.
